chunks: Do not eat from the meat of a baby lamb that suckles from the milk of a female pig.

key_terms.حَمَل: baby lamb (suckling lamb, distinct from an adult sheep)
key_terms.خِنْزِيرَة: female pig / sow (the feminine form of khinzir, pig)
key_terms.يَرْضِعُ: suckles / breast-feeds (from the verb rada'a, to nurse)

ai.seo_question: Is it halal to eat the meat of a lamb that was nursed by a pig?
ai.summary: This hadith delivers a concise jurisprudential ruling from the Imam (peace be upon him): it is forbidden (haram) to eat the meat of a lamb that has been nursed by a pig. The ruling reflects the Islamic principle that an animal's purity and permissibility for consumption can be affected by what it is fed, extending the prohibition of pork to animals contaminated by pig's milk. This teaching would have been understood by the original audience as an extension of the Quranic prohibition on pigs to cover cases of cross-nursing.
